stem.text: Light of wavelength $5.4 \times 10^{-7}\,\text{m}$ is incident normally on a diffraction grating.
The separation between adjacent lines in the grating is $2.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. The light that emerges from the grating falls on a semicircular screen, as shown in the view from above.

stem.alt: View from above of a light beam travelling right into a diffraction grating, in front of a semicircular screen, with the label VIEW FROM ABOVE.

stem.text: The grating is at the centre of the semicircle, and the lines of the grating are vertical.
How many bright dots are formed on the screen?
